about: Starter palette for a new song (22 November 2026). team-a and team-b are placeholder team colours (here Minnesota-like lake blue, midnight and aurora green): replace them with the song's real team colours. Every text colour must keep 3:1 contrast on its background, panel and ground (style.mjs checkPalette throws otherwise). Style ids not in viewer.html's table are drawn from these colours. Hero and accent styles carry the emphasis; plain and quiet carry the rest; pins fix a style on a word id or text.
